title.narrative: Resilient Livelihoods through Stronger Community Based Organizations in Palestine

description.narrative:
The project is implemented by the Economic and Social Development Center of Palestine (ESDC) across rural communities in the northern West Bank, primarily in Jenin and Tubas. It aims to strengthen the capacity of cooperatives and community-based organizations to enhance food security, economic resilience, and gender equality among smallholder farmers and rural households. By the end of 2028, cooperatives and producer groups supported by ESDC will have improved governance, service delivery, and access to financial and productive resources. Women and youth will play a greater role in leadership, value chain development, and income-generating activities. Expected results include: (1) strengthened cooperative structures and governance systems; (2) increased adoption of sustainable and climate-smart agricultural practices; (3) improved access to financial services through Village Savings and Loan Associations (VSLAs); and (4) enhanced market access and economic participation for women and youth. Key activities include training and mentoring for cooperative leaders, establishment of VSLAs, technical support on agroecology and production, market linkage development, and policy dialogue for cooperative rights.
The project contributes to the We Effect CSO Programme Together for Food Security in Palestine (2025-2028) by advancing a rights-based approach that promotes inclusive, democratic, and sustainable rural livelihoods.
